name: google-maps-scraper

description.en: scrape data  from Google Maps. Extracts data such as the name, address, phone number, website URL, rating,  reviews number, latitude and longitude, reviews,email and more for each place
description.zh: 从 Google Maps 抓取数据，提取商家名称、地址、电话、评分等信息。

install: git clone https://github.com/gosom/google-maps-scraper（按 README 导入 Codex）

ecosystems.install: git clone https://github.com/gosom/google-maps-scraper（按 README 导入 Codex）

audience.zh: 市场分析师、本地商家、数据采集者
audience.en: Market analysts, local businesses, data collectors

usecases.zh: 用于从 Google Maps 提取商家信息，如名称、地址、电话、评分等
usecases.en: For extracting business info from Google Maps: name, address, phone, rating, etc.

author: gosom
